tool_action.public_message: I'll sell a couple of houses from the Pink district to settle this rent. The Oranges are still doing well, so this is just a minor adjustment to my portfolio.
tool_action.private_thought: I owe $700 and only have $628. I need to raise $72. Selling 2 houses on my Pink monopoly will give me $100, which covers the debt. I'm choosing the Pinks to preserve the higher rent of the Orange monopoly. This will release 2 houses back into the bank, slightly weakening the house lock, but Grok still won't have the 3 houses he needs to reach the 4-house-per-property requirement for Hotels on his Reds. Maintaining solvency is the priority.
